original_source_statement_tex:
\label{lemma-sub-dp-ideal}
Let $(A, I, \gamma)$ be a divided power ring.
Let $E \subset I$ be a subset.
Then the smallest ideal $J \subset I$ preserved by $\gamma$
and containing all $f \in E$ is the ideal $J$ generated by
$\gamma_n(f)$, $n \geq 1$, $f \in E$.
stage_b_review_note: Source 642–649: for DP ideal I with γ and arbitrary E⊂I, the MINIMAL γ-stable ideal J⊂I containing E is the ideal generated by all γ_n(f), n≥1 and f∈E. Draft preserves both minimality and all indices, without restricting to E an ideal.
